messages:
ana: FYI discovered a subtle onboarding leak in the node sample quickstart: if you follow the doc it sets LOG_LEVEL=debug which prints req_id before redaction middleware initializes. Local devs can accidentally see full ids while following quickstart.

phil: Oof. Can you paste the minimal repro and where in the quickstart this happens?

ana: Steps: clone sample-node, follow quickstart (export LOG_LEVEL=debug, REDACT=1, OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:4318), start, hit /oauth which does a 401->200 retry. Logs show first auth info with req_id clear, final success line redacted. Snippet:
```
DEBUG auth: start flow user=alice req_id=req-777
DEBUG http: refresh attempt=1
INFO  auth: success user=alice req_id=<redacted>
```
Span attributes show req_id=req-777. The issue is the quickstart enables debug logging which causes certain debug lines to be emitted before middleware attaches the structured req_id to the context. Redaction only runs later.

sam: Interesting edgecase: debug gives more log events and changes timing. Two quick fixes: update quickstart to recommend LOG_LEVEL=info (not debug) for initial onboarding, and change sample code to attach req_id as structured field on the span at handler entry.

phil: I agree on changing quickstart wording. New devs will run exactly those steps. We should add a short callout about log-level and ordering. Also add a tiny sample snippet showing where to create the span early.

ana: Proposed snippet for node: 
```js
app.use((req,res,next)=>{
  const reqId = req.headers['x-request-id'] || uuid();
  req.reqId = reqId;
  const span = tracer.startSpan('request', {attributes: {req_id: reqId}});
  req.span = span;
  next();
});
```
That fixed it locally for me.

sam: Can we also make the redaction middleware prefer span attributes before regexing formatted text? That will make the redactor robust even if debug leaks a timing window.

phil: Longer term yes, but for onboarding patch let's do: (1) update quickstart wording to LOG_LEVEL=info, (2) add the snippet to sample app, (3) add a smoke test that forces a 401->200 retry and asserts logs are consistent. Then follow-up to make middleware span-aware.

ana: I'll open the quickstart PR and include the snippet + a one-liner note about why ordering matters.

doc-bot: Created DOCS-2024: "quickstart: avoid debug log-level; ensure req_id attached early to prevent local redaction leaks" https://redwood.internal/DOCS-2024

sam: Nice. Can you also paste the log snippet and repro into the ticket so support can reference it if new users ping?

ana: Done. If anyone wants to mirror the change across go/rust/python samples, that would be great.

phil: I'll take go. Sam can grab python. Closing loop: thanks for catching this early, ana.
